scripts.lint: redocly lint openapi.yaml --config redocly.yaml && npm run check:backend
scripts.build: npm run check:backend && redocly build-docs openapi.yaml --config redocly.yaml --output dist/index.html && node scripts/render-client-only.mjs dist/index.html && node scripts/build-backend-board.mjs dist/openapi.json dist/board.html
scripts.check:backend: npm run bundle:json && node scripts/check-backend.mjs dist/openapi.json
